title: useMemo vs useCallback: result or function?

slides.text: Cache the result, or the recipe? 🧁
slides.say: Use memo and use callback look alike. The difference is what they keep.
Use memo calls your function and caches its result. Here, the requirements object stays the same until product changes.
Use callback doesn’t call your function. It caches the function itself. The code only runs later, on submit.
In fact, use callback is like use memo returning a function. Same idea, one less wrapper.

slides.text: Need a computed value? useMemo. Need the same function? useCallback.
slides.say: Both help when you pass things to a memoized child. Value? Use memo. Function? Use callback.
